target.title: fix(crestodian): keep assistant prompt history truncation UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes a UTF-16 surrogate-pair truncation bug in `formatHistory()` within `src/crestodian/assistant-prompts.ts`. When a conversation history turn containing emoji or other supplementary-plane characters exceeds the 500-character `HISTORY_TURN_MAX_CHARS` limit, the raw `String.prototype.slice(0, 500)` can split a surrogate pair at the truncation boundary, producing a lone surrogate character (U+FFFD replacement character) in the model-facing prompt text.

This is the same bug class fixed in #102483 (startup context), #102470 (chat display), #102414 (Codex app inventory), and #102509 (Codex dynamic tool timeout logs).

## Why This Change Was Made

Crestodian assistant prompts assemble conversation history before sending it to the planner model. Emoji in user/assistant turns (e.g., 🎉, 🦀, 🐚) are common. A split surrogate pair corrupts the prompt text visible to the model, which can degrade model output quality or produce garbled text in operator-facing logs.

The fix replaces `turn.text.slice(0, HISTORY_TURN_MAX_CHARS)` with `truncateUtf16Safe(turn.text, HISTORY_TURN_MAX_CHARS)`, which floors the limit to avoid returning a dangling surrogate at either edge. This is the same pattern used in all merged UTF-16 surrogate-pair fixes.

The constant `HISTORY_TURN_MAX_CHARS` and helper `formatHistory` remain module-private (not exported), consistent with the "Keep APIs narrow" principle and the pattern in all comparable merged PRs.

## User Impact

Operators and developers using the Crestodian assistant loop with emoji-containing conversation turns will now receive valid UTF-16 text in the model prompt instead of broken surrogate characters at the truncation boundary. No changes to tool execution, timeout behavior, protocol payloads, or persisted data.

## Evidence

- Current `main` uses `turn.text.slice(0, HISTORY_TURN_MAX_CHARS)` in `formatHistory()`, which can split surrogate pairs.
- Colocated regression test: 3 tests passed, including emoji-at-boundary and multi-emoji-at-boundary assertions (`not.toContain("\uFFFD")`).
- Existing `assistant.test.ts`: 7 tests passed (no regression).
- Format/lint: `oxfmt` clean, `oxlint` 0 warnings/errors, `git diff --check` clean.



AI-assisted;
